claims: The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.

The official kick-off of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match is scheduled for 3:00 pm BST.
The live YouTube stream of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match begins with pre-match coverage, typically starting around 2:10 pm BST.
2:10 pm BST is equivalent to 9:10 am ET for the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match stream start.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match can be watched on the official Sidemen YouTube Channel.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match features Sidemen FC against the YouTube All-Stars.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match is played to raise money for various charities.
